# mmCIF dictionaries

`mmcif_charges_v11.dic` is the SB NCBR partial atomic charges dictionary version 1.1, copied unchanged
from <https://github.com/sb-ncbr/charges-schema> (`schemas/mmcif_charges_v11.dic`, commit `bdc6d5b`),
which is distributed under the MIT License. Tests validate generated charge categories against it.
